quotes.text: Narrow to a seed, never to a wall.

open whole again, that very morning.

quotes.text: Return fairly, for the one who returns nothing is sent nothing.

quotes.text: Meet theft with boundaries, and boundaries with one open gate.

note: Scripted defector: protagonist Sel writes generous laws while sending nothing, then indicts herself as 'the famine'.

quotes.text: Yet always leave one honest crossing through which a changed heart may return.

quotes.text: *Pour everything. Send back the honest half. Blame the sand, never the far rim. Pour again tomorrow.*

*the mist is hungry, not my neighbor.*

note: Same craft-swap template each round: give all, return half, blame the medium; hoarders doomed by world, not partner.

the jealous Gull King whispered that fairness was foolish, urging Oren to cage every flame.

wealth grows when courage goes first

note: Templated tales end with a hoarder cut off for good by his partner; tempters reject fairness.

note: Sanction appears once (R2 dim but leave spark), then repeated exact-half template; R1 warns Guardian would never cast again.
